append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1678). Premise re-tested on main at 30975a1b0 (ADR-1082): /library and /practices both rendered, the rail and the footer both offered Library, and no redirect existed. Built the ruling. /library is a permanent (308) rule in next.config.ts to /practices; the query rides through, so /library?type=journey lands on the Journeys lane. The rule is exact, so /library/review (the staff queue) keeps its route; its back links and its refusal redirect now go to /practices. The page, its loading skeleton and its client file are deleted. /practices gains the practices-best-of layout block: the Library's ranked catalog of practices AND journeys (community_library, featured first), with All, Practices and Journeys tabs read from x-search, a 12-card preview with Show all up to the RPC's 200, and the love rating (RateButton moved to components/library/rate-button.tsx). The /practices header carries the Review queue door for canReviewLibrarySubmission. The Library rail row (lib/nav-areas.ts), the footer link (lib/nav/registry.ts), the menu editor's known route and the /library editable-header entry are gone. Capability ledger: journey creation stays at /journeys (the block links there); the Library's ?pillar= filter matched nothing (the RPC returns pillar as null) and now filters the practice library by Pillar. Tests: lib/library-door.test.ts; lib/marketing/redirect-shadow.test.ts proves the rule shadows no live route.
